description: Generate conventional commit messages from git diffs and staged changes. Use when: (1) user asks to write/generate/commit a commit message, (2) running git commit and needs a message, (3) user asks "what should my commit message be?" or "help me commit", (4) preparing changes for a PR and the commit message follows Conventional Commits format. NOT for: running git commands directly (use exec for that), rebasing, or resolving merge conflicts.
